literature_notes: The sole ledger entry (L1) describes a full-length MS4A2 (FcεRI-β) construct fused to mNG, mEGFP, or mScarlet via a GGGGS linker (DNA: GGTGGAGGCGGTAGC). MS4A2 is a four-pass transmembrane protein whose N-terminus (residues 1–59) and C-terminus (residues 198–244) are both intracellular; its only extracellular-facing regions are ECL1 (81–101) and ECL2 (151–181). The paper does not describe a loop insertion, does not name any residue or junction, and does not place the fluorescent protein on the extracellular face. The fusion is at an intracellular terminus (C-terminal is standard for MS4A-family proteins and consistent with the construct description). Because no extracellular surface tag is reported anywhere in the ledger, zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length MS4A2 fused to mNG/mEGFP/mScarlet via GGGGS linker at the intracellular C-terminus (residues 198–244); no extracellular placement described.
